sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for asset 234463 (per-site catalog), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $16 per single site per night (group day-use site $60); $5 for an extra vehicle left at the site over 30 minutes, or park it in the overflow area.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/yaak-river-campground ('Single Site: $16 per night ... Group Site: $60 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234463/rates (2026 Peak Season: StandardNonelectric 16) + recreation.gov notice ('you will need to pay the $5 extra vehicle fee or move the vehicle to the Overflow Parking Area'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/yaak-river-campground ('$16.00 daily fee per single site 50% discount with US Golden Age/Access or Interagency Senior/Access Passes'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234463 (all 45 overnight sites typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov's catalog lists 45 first-come family sites (each Max Vehicle Length 30 ft) plus a day-use group site; its description says 45 sites including one host site, the Forest Service page says 44 including the host. Seven are pull-throughs; FS gives an average length of 32 ft. Sites on both sides of the Yaak River.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/yaak-river-campground ('The campground has 44 sites, including one host site ... Seven sites are pull-throughs most offering an average length of 32'') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234463 ('The campground has 45 sites, including one host site') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234463 (45 STANDARD NONELECTRIC Overnight sites, Max Vehicle Length 30), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water, garbage service and firewood during the peak (managed) season. Primitive boat ramp to the Kootenai River in Loop B.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234463 ('Vault toilets, garbage service, firewood and drinking water are available during the peak season'; amenity 'Drinking Water (peak season)'; 'A boat ramp located in Loop B gives access to the Kootenai River') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/yaak-river-campground ('Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Managed (host, water, fees) May through September; the Forest Service says the campground 'is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/yaak-river-campground (Operational Hours: 'The campground is managed from May through September, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: All overnight sites are first come, first served and saving sites is prohibited. Only the group day-use area (Loop A, 10 am - 10 pm) is reservable, on recreation.gov or through the Three Rivers Ranger District. 16-night stay limit.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234463 (notices 'All sites are first come-first serve. Saving sites is prohibited', '16 Day Stay Limit in overnight campsites'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16; 'The campground campsites are not currently on the reservation system') + recreation.gov catalog (the only reservable unit is the GROUP STANDARD AREA, type of use Day) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/yaak-river-campground ('a group area that can be rented for the day'), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai NF, 7 mi NW of Troy on Hwy 2 at the confluence of the Yaak and Kootenai rivers; sites on both sides of the Yaak, garbage service in season. Run by the Three Rivers Ranger District. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov: confirmed $16 (2026), no hookups, vault toilets/drinking water, 45 sites with pull-throughs, senior/access 50% discount. Changed booking reservable true/recreation.gov/some_sites -> not reservable, platform cleared, fcfs always (only the group DAY-use area is reservable); added 16-night limit, 30-ft catalog max, year-round availability (managed May-Sept). Note corrected (the group site is day use) and trimmed. Operated by the Forest Service (Three Rivers RD), FCFS. No FS alert covers the campground or US-2.
